title: 质数减法运算
summary: 每个下标至多一次减去一个严格小于当前值的质数，判断能否让数组严格递增。
insight: 从左到右固定前一个结果 previous。当前值应尽可能小以给后续留空间，因此减去严格小于 nums[i]-previous 的最大质数；这样结果仍大于 previous，且任何其他可行选择都不会更优。
pitfalls: 所减质数必须严格小于原值
结果序列要求严格递增
质数必须小于 nums[i]-previous 而不能等于

solutions.title: 筛质数并贪心减最大可行质数
solutions.idea: 让每个当前位置取可行的最小结果。
steps: 筛出不超过 max(nums) 的所有质数
对每个 value，若 value<=previous 返回 false
limit=value-previous，二分找严格小于 limit 的最大质数
若存在则 current=value-prime，否则 current=value

complexity.time: O(M log log M + n log π(M))

code.java: class Solution { public boolean primeSubOperation(int[] nums){int maximum=Arrays.stream(nums).max().getAsInt();boolean[] composite=new boolean[maximum+1];List<Integer> primes=new ArrayList<>();for(int number=2;number<=maximum;number++){if(!composite[number]){primes.add(number);if((long)number*number<=maximum)for(int multiple=number*number;multiple<=maximum;multiple+=number)composite[multiple]=true;}}int previous=0;for(int value:nums){if(value<=previous)return false;int limit=value-previous,index=Collections.binarySearch(primes,limit);index=index>=0?index-1:-index-2;if(index>=0)value-=primes.get(index);previous=value;}return true;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun primeSubOperation(nums:IntArray):Boolean{val maximum=nums.maxOrNull()!!;val composite=BooleanArray(maximum+1);val primes=mutableListOf<Int>();for(number in 2..maximum)if(!composite[number]){primes.add(number);if(number.toLong()*number<=maximum){var multiple=number*number;while(multiple<=maximum){composite[multiple]=true;multiple+=number}}};var previous=0;for(original in nums){if(original<=previous)return false;val limit=original-previous;var left=0;var right=primes.size;while(left<right){val middle=(left+right)/2;if(primes[middle]<limit)left=middle+1 else right=middle};var current=original;if(left>0)current-=primes[left-1];previous=current};return true} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:bool primeSubOperation(vector<int>& nums){int maximum=*max_element(nums.begin(),nums.end());vector<bool> composite(maximum+1);vector<int> primes;for(int number=2;number<=maximum;++number)if(!composite[number]){primes.push_back(number);if(1LL*number*number<=maximum)for(int multiple=number*number;multiple<=maximum;multiple+=number)composite[multiple]=true;}int previous=0;for(int value:nums){if(value<=previous)return false;int limit=value-previous;auto iterator=lower_bound(primes.begin(),primes.end(),limit);if(iterator!=primes.begin())value-=*prev(iterator);previous=value;}return true;} };
